## The search

The section videos stay in place and cover each other; on the website that
stacking is `manim.css` (`.manim-stack`), reveal's `.no-transition` rules are not
attached here.

::: {.explain-manim}
```{.python .manim}
from manim import *


class DefaultTemplate(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        self.next_section("board")
        self.next_section("window")
```

The board.
